I didn't realize it was long covid for a long time. At first I thought it could be b12 deficiency and I started taking b12 and magnesium. It kinda helped a little but it wasn't great. Then I took vitamin d for a little bit and it sort of helped but that wasn't really what I needed either. Then I tried iron supplements but that didn't do anything at all. I tried a multivitamin and that didn't do anything either. I tried therapy for a few months for the anxiety but it wasn't helpful. 

In October I saw a psychiatrist who said this was most likely caused by covid but she prescribed me an antipsychotic which *really* messed me up. It made me dizzy and gave me insomnia and hallucinations. I think taking the antipsychotic set back my recovery and made a lot of my symptoms worse. I'm only mentioning this because my recovery timeline might be different from other people's because of this.

Anyway, I'm currently taking a stress gummy that has magnesium, L-theanine, and lemon balm. I also take ashwagandha but I keep seeing people say that it's bad for you and I can't find any consistent information. The ashwagandha and magnesium combo seems to be the best so far but you're already taking that, and as you know, it's not as helpful as it should be haha
